name: Dentiva
tagline: The quiet operating system for the solo dental practice.
positioning: Dentiva runs scheduling, recalls, and insurance follow-up for independent dentists — so the chair stays full without a front-desk pileup.

hero.h1: Your practice, running calmly in the background.
hero.sub: Dentiva handles the recalls, the reschedules, and the insurance chases that quietly drain your day — so you and one assistant can run a full book without a phone that never stops.

features.title: Recall that actually returns
features.description: Dentiva watches for the six-month gap, drafts the reminder in your voice, and books the hygiene slot before the patient forgets — no spreadsheet, no sticky notes.

features.title: Claims that don't sit in limbo
features.description: Every submitted claim is tracked to payment. When a payer stalls past 14 days, Dentiva flags it and prepares the resubmission for a one-click send.

features.title: A chair that stays full
features.description: Cancellations trigger an instant waitlist offer to the right patient. Most gaps close before you've finished the current appointment.

features.title: One clear morning huddle
features.description: A single readable sheet each morning: who's coming, what's outstanding, which balances to collect. No twelve open tabs.

features.title: Balances collected gently
features.description: Automated, plainly worded payment reminders that patients actually respond to — with a link that settles the balance in two taps.

features.title: Your data stays yours
features.description: HIPAA-aligned storage, encrypted at rest, with a full export whenever you want it. No lock-in, no games.

testimonials.quote: I let my second front-desk role go — not because I had to, but because Dentiva quietly covered the recalls and claims that used to eat that whole seat. My book is fuller than it's ever been.
testimonials.name: Dr. Elena Marchetti

testimonials.quote: The claims tracking alone paid for the year. Payers can't quietly sit on our money anymore — Dentiva surfaces the stall and hands me the resubmission ready to go.
testimonials.name: Priya Raman

testimonials.quote: I'm a solo dentist with one assistant. Dentiva feels like the operations person I could never quite afford to hire. Mornings are calm now.
testimonials.name: Dr. Thomas Okafor

pricing.blurb: For the single-chair dentist running lean.
For multi-provider offices and small groups.

homepage.footerBlurb: Dentiva is the calm operating system for independent dental practices. Built for the dentist who'd rather be in the chair than on the phone.
